summary: Tested book-only FanDuel/DraftKings triple-double rows in the TD Scanner for MEM vs POR (26OCT29MEMPOR). Backend: 5/5 pytest passed. With td_pts=10 it returns 3 book-only rows (deni avdija fd+2500/dk+2400, cameron boozer fd+3000/dk+4000, ja morant dk+7800), each with combos=[]. books.enabled=true and credits_left='491'. With td_pts=15 it returns no rows and books={}. UI: all rows rendered with TD '—', 'no Kalshi combo', green prefilled FD/DK inputs and EV '—'. Typing +3000 kept the value and turned it white. Clearing left the box empty, and it stayed empty after switching 15->10. Switching to 15+ showed 0 rows plus the empty-state message. About 6 backend calls used.

minor.issue: Ja Morant shows team 'POR' in MEM vs POR (Kalshi/ESPN team_of lookup). Check whether this is real roster data or a team mix-up.
extra.sort uses min(v for v in books.values() if v is not None). It raises ValueError (500) if a book-only player's prices are all None. Use min(..., default=inf).
books.credits_left is a string ('491'), not an int.

issues: A cleared FD/DK box is saved as '' in localStorage, so it stays empty for good and the live green odds never come back. Consider a reset-to-live control, or treat '' as 'use auto'.
When every row is book-only, 'Bet on Kalshi' falls back to the generic kalshi.com/combos/basketball/nba link (harmless).
